falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically featured shallow drawdowns with strong support at higher levels; a break below 4,800 would violate the structural floor implied by the 78% pattern match, indicating this is not a comparable bottom formation but rather a breakdown into a deeper correction

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests elevated but controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic-level fear rather than the capitulation-then-stabilization dynamic seen in August 2024 bottoms, invalidating the pattern similarity

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by 0.50% or more)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred during curve steepening/positive carry; a severe inversion would signal recessionary de-risking rather than the growth-scare-recovery dynamic embedded in the matched pattern, proving the macro regime has shifted fundamentally
